meta.name: Wonderful World
meta.description: A mother who unfairly lost her young son, takes revenge against the perpetrator who has been forgiven by the law and heals her wounds.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Soo-hyun loses her son in an accident. When the perpetrator receives leniency, she seeks revenge.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Soo-hyun is imprisoned for seeking revenge. She is released after seven years with a duty to fulfill.

meta.slogan: It all collapsed in an instant.
